info.cls_ename: College of Humanities and Social Sciences

description.describe_ch: 本課程從法國電影新浪潮、印象派繪畫、日本動漫、人文攝影、搖滾與流行音樂等多元媒介，介紹二十世紀後的法國獨特的社會背景與文化現象，從影視名人的形象風格，到小說刻畫的虛構人物，探討法式風格建構，對當代法國的文化語境建立初步的了解。
description.describe_eh: This course engages with related cultural phenomena that have shaped French culture after the 20th century, such as French New Waves, impressionist paintings, Japanese comic books, and humanist photography. From French icons to fictional characters, we will explore the forging of French style through textual and contextual investigation in contemporary France.

targets.describe_ch: 對法國文化語境以及相關論述有基本了解
targets.describe_en: To acquire a basic understanding of cultural context in France and relevant theories.

targets.describe_ch: 將跨文化的理解應用在溝通與理論論述
targets.describe_en: Apply transcultural comprehension in communication and theoretic discourses.

textBooks.tpb_book_en:
This course engages with related cultural phenomena that have shaped French culture after the 20th century, such as French New Waves, impressionist paintings, Japanese comic books, and humanist photography. From French icons to fictional characters, we will explore the forging of French style through textual and contextual investigation in contemporary France.
 
Reading materials will be assigned in class.

The French New Wave

柏金、甘斯柏格，流行樂與法國
From Sarah Bernhardt to Jane Birkin, Gainsbourg, pop music in France

The Flâneur in literature, cinema, and Japanese comic books

女性崛起，華達與「她」者
The rise of women, Agnès Varda and the Other

gradeRuleDescribe.tpa_score_new_en:
評分規則說明
課程包括三次平時考試或是申論題問答筆試，至少須有兩次參與紀錄才可繳交或是參與期中考試與小組期末呈現。
期中報告相關要求將於課程中公告。
課程部分規劃為小組討論，與課學生需積極參與課題討論。此位，課程內包含小組口頭報告呈現，需以團隊工作的模式擬定主題並發表口頭報告。兩部分表現皆列平時成績評量。
 
Grading Policy Explanation
The course includes three regular quizzes or written exams with short-answer/essay questions. Students must have records of participation in at least two of these in order to be eligible to submit the individual midterm report.
Requirements related to the midterm report will be announced during the course.
Part of the course is organized around group discussions, and enrolled students are expected to actively participate in topic discussions. In addition, the course includes group oral presentations, which require students to work in teams and deliver oral presentations. Performance in both parts will be included in the assessment of regular coursework grades.
gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol:
Course Policies
課程講授與討論並重，每週會固定安排部分時間個別問答或是分組討論，需要同學保持彈性，積極極參。 
課程包括三次平時考試或是申論題問答筆試，至少須有兩次參與紀錄才可繳交或是參與個人期中報告。 
平時考試或是申論題問答期間禁止使用任何電子設備。 
未經許可、課程請勿錄音拍照或攝影。請同學以電子或是書面筆記紀錄講課內容。 
彈性授課內容包含實體授課或線上自主學習，於期末考試與口頭報告結束之後實施。 
所有課程規則將於課堂內公告與口頭說明。 除特殊情況，若對於課堂內已公告或是討論的內容，有相關疑問，請同學親至課堂內提出問題，否則不另外通知或回覆線上傳送的訊息。 
＊本課程將視課程進行情況調整授課進度＊
The course places equal emphasis on lectures and discussion. Each week, a portion of class time will be regularly allocated to individual Q&A or group discussions. Students are expected to remain flexible and participate actively.
The course includes three regular quizzes or written exams with short-answer/essay questions. Students must have records of participation in at least two of these in order to be eligible to submit or participate in the individual midterm report.
The use of any electronic devices is prohibited during quizzes or written exams.
Audio recording, photography, or video recording of the class is not permitted without prior approval. Students should take notes using electronic devices or handwritten notes to record lecture content.
Flexible instructional components may include in-person teaching or online self-directed learning, which will be implemented after the final examination and oral presentations are completed.
All course rules will be announced and explained orally in class. Except in special circumstances, if students have questions regarding content that has already been announced or discussed in class, they should raise them in person during class time. Otherwise, no additional notifications will be given, and online messages will not be responded to.
The course schedule and progress may be adjusted depending on the overall course development.

The use of any electronic devices is prohibited during quizzes or written exams.
Audio recording, photography, or video recording of the class is not permitted without prior approval. Students should take notes using electronic devices or handwritten notes to record lecture content.
Flexible instructional components may include in-person teaching or online self-directed learning, which will be implemented after the final examination and oral presentations are completed.
All course rules will be announced and explained orally in class. Except in special circumstances, if students have questions regarding content that has already been announced or discussed in class, they should raise them in person during class time. Otherwise, no additional notifications will be given, and online messages will not be responded to.
The course schedule and progress may be adjusted depending on the overall course development.
